hypothesis: Fixed singleton micro-batching removes E007's dependence on evaluator batch composition while preserving its canonical single-sample outputs and remaining safely below the five-minute limit.

public_contract_windows.purpose: contract testing only; not model selection evidence

local_gpu_whole_run_proxy.construction: cycle the two public contract windows; no additional field data
local_gpu_whole_run_proxy.interpretation: supplementary RTX 5050/Torch 2.7.1 evidence for the A800/Torch 2.2.2 limit

controls: Only the internal point-model micro-batch size changes from E007.
No E002 validation target or prediction is read by E008.
The E005 checkpoint, normalizer, E006 interval, public inputs, tolerances, and archive contents remain frozen.
The E008 public batch-1 prediction and bounds must exactly match E007's official-image hashes.
The official container remains networkless, capability-free, and read-only outside /tmp and the result mount.
decision_rule: Promote and retain the archive only if every unchanged E007 gate passes, batch-1 and batch-2 outputs satisfy the frozen tolerance, the canonical E007 batch-1 hashes match exactly, and the 357-sample GPU proxy remains below 300 seconds.
